CIRCLE · Version 21.8 · Founder-only
ONBOARDING STUDIO · DEMO

One process.
Every new partner.

Register fictional businesses, prepare internal onboarding checklists, model nonbinding setup fees and commissions, and propose illustrative lifestyle plan pricing. Reuse existing CIRCLE businesses instead of duplicating records.

Requires CIRCLE V21.5 Supabase setup.

01 · Register a DEMO business

Create a new fictional hotel, restaurant, lounge or company. If it already exists in Partnership Network, select it under step 02 instead.

Draft registration does not publish a real partner, create employee access or sign a contract.

02 · Reusable onboarding checklist

Choose a fictional partner or company.

All four checks mark the business Internally ready · DEMO, never commercially approved.

03 · Draft commercial terms

Prepare a reusable, Founder-owned commercial proposal for the selected partner or company. Figures are not invoices, receivables, payments or contractual obligations.

04 · Founder scenario calculator

Calculates a scenario from the selected business’s proposed fees and hypothetical memberships. V21.8 keeps separate assumptions for each business during this signed-in page session. Reloading or signing out resets assumptions. Never labels this as earned revenue.

Choose a business to see an illustrative scenario.
Scenario figures are gross hypothetical Founder fees before operating costs or taxes. No real money has been earned or received.

Commercial Proposal Studio · V21.8

Uses saved commercial terms for the selected business. Hidden figures are excluded from the exported document. Draft only.

05 · Lifestyle membership pricing

Propose changes to demo Gold, Platinum or other lifestyle plan list prices. A separate Founder confirmation is required before applying the proposed price.

Applying a DEMO catalog price does not bill members or retroactively change approved entitlements.

06 · Business onboarding register

Reuse the same pipeline for hotel/lifestyle partners and corporate clients. Records created before V21.5 start as unreviewed until their checklist is saved.

Internal pilot only. "Internally ready" is not a verified legal business, executed contract, consent, insurance check, regulated payment approval or authorization to provide actual discounts. Independent security testing, privacy and commercial legal review are mandatory before production use.
CIRCLE · VERSION 21.3 · SECURITY & ACCOUNTABILITY
DEMO SECURITY LAB

Real-account verification.
Visible audit trail.

Test Founder-only access from an actual signed-in non-Founder account. Founders can review the server-recorded lifecycle of subscriptions, eligibility and one-time partner codes. No real payments or commercial privileges.

New audit events begin after the V21.3 migration. Older approvals and corporate changes are shown separately as legacy records, not reconstructed audit events.

Requires CIRCLE V21.3 database setup.

01 · Authenticated account security test

Uses your current signed-in CIRCLE account to call the three restricted Supabase RPCs with null record IDs. The expected response to each is Founder only. No real request or entitlement can be changed by these probes.

02 · Revoked / expired eligibility guard

The existing V21.1 server checks eligibility at code issuance and again at verification. This panel attempts a DEMO code request only when an offer is restricted to a route that your account no longer has active eligibility for. A rejected request is a PASS; otherwise a security problem is reported.

If no suitable corporate-only or individual-only test offer exists, this check is marked NOT TESTED. An active entitlement for another route must never be mistaken for a negative test.

01 · Server-created audit events

Founder-only read access. Audit records cannot be inserted, edited or deleted by the app's authenticated roles. This is an operational log, not an independently tamper-proof or compliance-certified audit system.

02 · Earlier V21.2 transaction history

These are original subscription approvals and corporate events recorded before the V21.3 audit existed. They are not backdated audit entries.

V21.3 is still a test pilot. Production launch requires independent security assessment, real identity and payment safeguards, partner contracts, legal review, recovery and incident controls.

Commercial Planner
